meta.name: doc-coauthoring
meta.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按结构化流程协作撰写文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要与他人协作撰写结构化的文档或提案
copy.tagline_en: Collaborate on structured documentation with a guided workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to co-author structured documents or proposals with others

howto.what: Claude 会带你分三步写文档:先收集背景上下文,再逐节头脑风暴、筛选、打磨,最后用全新 Claude 做读者测试。产出是逐节确认、放在 artifact 或 markdown 文件里的文档。
howto.when: 当你提到写文档、提案、技术规格等结构化内容,或开始一项较大的写作任务时,Claude 会提议按这套三段流程协作。

say.text: 我想写一份技术规格,带我走一遍这个协作流程
say.note: 会先问文档类型、读者等背景问题

say.text: 开始下一节吧,先给我 10 个可选的要点
say.note: 进入头脑风暴与筛选环节

say.text: 用全新 Claude 测一下这份文档,看读者会不会误解
say.note: 进入第三阶段读者测试

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through three stages to co-write a document: gathering context, refining it section by section, then reader-testing it with a fresh Claude. Output lands in an artifact or a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention writing docs, proposals, tech specs, or similar structured content, or start a substantial writing task; Claude then offers this three-stage workflow.

say_en.text: I need to write a technical spec—walk me through this co-authoring workflow
say_en.note: Starts with questions about type and audience

say_en.text: Let's do the next section—brainstorm 10 candidate points for me
Test this doc with a fresh Claude to see if readers get confused
